sentences.text: Barnesiella intestinihominis is a human intestinal bacterium.
A growth assay showed that it can use complex-type N-glycan, a host-derived glycan, as a carbon source, and RNA-seq identified the enzymes and transporters involved.
A study of 96 Mongolian participants reported that Barnesiella intestinihominis was significantly reduced in overweight individuals.
A paper reported that a previous metagenomic analysis found a significant deficiency of this species in patients with impaired glucose regulation, a prediabetic state.
